entities.summary: Ramon Bernard Harewood is a Barbadian former professional American football offensive tackle. He played college football at Morehouse College in Atlanta, Georgia. He was selected in the sixth round of the 2010 NFL draft, with the Ravens signing him to a three-year contract.
